name: ai-project-designer
description: Plan projects with a Planner LLM and execute each task through an isolated Pi Agent run driven by a Python process boundary.

commands.title: AI Project Designer: Run Current Task
AI Project Designer: Check Pi Runtime

aiProjectDesigner.planner.provider.description: Pi provider id used by the Planner (e.g. deepseek). Empty means Pi's default provider.

aiProjectDesigner.planner.model.description: Pi model id used by the Planner (the most capable model available).

aiProjectDesigner.planner.thinking.description: Pi thinking level for the Planner: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Empty means Pi's default.

aiProjectDesigner.planner.timeout.description: Planner Pi run timeout in milliseconds (the sidebar edits it in seconds).

aiProjectDesigner.planner.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: Markdown system prompt sent to the Planner LLM. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt. Editable from the sidebar Settings tab with a live Markdown preview.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.command.description: Pi CLI executable. This configures the integration runtime, not an alternative LLM provider.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.mode.description: Pi output mode. The runner implements the one-shot 'json' event stream used for isolated task execution.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.noSession.description: Run every task as an ephemeral, no-session Pi execution. Required for task isolation.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.contextWindow.markdownDescription: Effective context window in tokens of the executor model, used by the sidebar usage bar. 0 uses the size Pi reports, which is the model maximum, not the length your local runtime actually loads (e.g. LM Studio can serve 131072 of a 262144 model).

aiProjectDesigner.pi.agentDir.description: Optional Pi config directory (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR). Leave empty to use Pi's own configuration.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.provider.description: Optional Pi provider override, forwarded to the Pi CLI. Pi remains the agentic runtime.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.model.description: Optional Pi model override, forwarded to the Pi CLI. Pi remains the agentic runtime.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.thinking.description: Pi thinking level for task execution: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Empty means Pi's default.

aiProjectDesigner.pi.trustProjectFiles.description: When false, Pi runs with --no-approve and ignores project-local files/extensions. Keep false for untrusted repositories.

aiProjectDesigner.ui.fontSize.description: Sidebar base font size in px. 0 follows the VS Code font size.

scripts.package:vsix: vsce package --out ai-project-designer.vsix && python scripts/check_vsix.py ai-project-designer.vsix
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:python
